notes: Statement change, equivalent: `MultilinearMap ℤ` becomes `MultilinearMap (RingHom.id ℤ)` (printed `→ₘₗ[ℤ]`) in `expand`, `form`, `form_cast`, `form_smul`, `form_cont` and `siu_num`. Mathlib generalized `MultilinearMap` to maps semilinear over a ring hom, so `MultilinearMap ℤ M N` no longer elaborates. Over `RingHom.id ℤ` the fields `toFun` and `map_update_add'` are the pinned ones and `map_update_smul'` reads `RingHom.id ℤ c • _`, definitionally the pinned `c • _`. Also `simp only [RingHom.id_apply]` after `map_smul_univ`.
